knowledgeAnswers.rationale: VBA note (2018), section on when a barrier is needed: pools and spas deeper than 300 mm need a complying barrier.
VBA note (2018), scope section: fish ponds, fountains and birdbaths are left out, along with the other listed exclusions.
VBA note (2018), definitions: the pool zone is the walled-off part around the water, and the entire parcel does not qualify.

practicalCriteria: For a supplied list of features, sorts each as inside or outside the rule and records the reason from depth and use.
Identifies the pool zone in a supplied site description as its own enclosed area and says why the whole lot does not qualify.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Scope record for the assessed site
stopWorkCriteria: Pool or spa deeper than 300 mm with no complying barrier: stop work on the water and escalate.
Scope uncertain: stop and confirm with the building surveyor before proceeding.
